scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/service packages/server packages/cli packages/web/src scripts site
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun scripts/check_headers.ts && bun scripts/check_portability.ts && bun scripts/check_licenses.ts && bun run test
scripts.build: bun run build:web && bun run build:server
scripts.build:web: cd packages/web && bun run vite build
scripts.docker:smoke: bun run docker && bun run scripts/docker_smoke.ts
scripts.site:preview: bun run site:build && cd site && bun run vite preview
scripts.cf:dev: cd packages/cloudflare && bun run wrangler dev
scripts.cf:test: cd packages/cloudflare && bun run vitest run
scripts.cf:types: cd packages/cloudflare && bun run wrangler types --strict-vars false
scripts.cf:build: cd packages/cloudflare && bun run wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --env production --containers-rollout none
scripts.cf:check: cd packages/cloudflare && bun run types:check && bun run typecheck && cd ../.. && bun run cf:fixtures --check && bun run cf:test && bun run cf:build
scripts.docker:workflow: bun run build:cli && bun run scripts/docker_workflow.ts
